next.reason: A pointer: the ACCESS MODE, ALTERNATE RECORD KEY, ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED and RECORD KEY clauses are specified separately. 2023 keeps each in its own subclause (12.4.5.5, 12.4.5.6, 12.4.5.10, 12.4.5.12), with §2023:12.4.5.10.3 GR5 'The INDEXED phrase specifies that the file organization is indexed'. Merging the per-module clause descriptions is editorial.
